regeneratedLocally.note: Untracked outputs left in the worktree artifacts/ by local regeneration (single_pivot_field.py rim, station_clock logic).

criterion.passIf: All 12 cases keep and score both pipes with >= 1.83 mm support and >= 89.8 ms reset margin -> select fixed path
criterion.failIf: Any adverse carry loses a pipe -> detail the pan (measure the stow stop first)
criterion.caseSet: 2 scenarios (nominal, adverse mass/battery/admission) x 2 pipes x 3 registered field placements

batteryVoltageStep.effect: clocked_bus.run (branch-voltage replay) removed from an in-memory copy of limited_field.py; field support, reset, carry and motor-side current are unaffected.

fixedPath.method: The pan solver (single_pivot_spatial.mjs, sha 7a921f81) with the same limited_pan.mjs route/inertia coupling, admission, clock and field placements; receiver held rigidly at -8 deg with the blockout profile substituted; release by a scripted zero-net-displacement chassis manoeuvre at the pan tip-start clock (2 m/s^2 back-off, 0.35 m/s creep, 9 m/s^2 stop).
fixedPath.geometryNote: Retained 430 x 322 mm floor footprint, side walls and slotted aft wall; sills Y=+/-242, cradle X~110/250 unchanged; no shaft, motor or stop.

fixed-notch-undamped.description: Blockout as defined: notch (8 mm rear bump, 4 mm play, 14 mm front lip), floor fixed at -8 deg, no damper

sectorPlacementNote: Both architectures use the baseline sectorM -0.18/+0.18; the FRC wiki records +180 mm overlapping the first settled pipe and recommends -180/+220. Not changed here.
limits: Fixed-path receivers that lost or kept the pipe without release were not passed to the finite field replay (no released state to replay).
Damper is an ideal linear translational drag in a fixed X window; brush friction on spin, compliance and wear are not modelled; values swept on the evaluated cases.
Release manoeuvre assumes a 9 m/s^2 bumper-assisted stop that was not qualified for traction or reef contact.
Five peer footprints are carried only through the inherited route clock; no new peer interaction was simulated.

verdict.selected: guarded pan (detail the pan; measure the stow stop first)
verdict.reason: Every fixed-path variant, undamped and damped, loses at least one pipe in the adverse cases before scoring, which meets the FAIL condition irrespective of the open battery step.
